method: Fresh visual inspection of all four frozen original-page PNGs, both original column crops for every page, all complete region overlays and the two counter/component overlays including expanded page-11 artwork. All 135 ledger rows were read in bounded per-page sections and compared to visible source; all 22 component observations and boundaries compared. Existing original images and prior reviewed coverage were hash-verified. No old derivation helper or transcript was read. Six fresh root structural validations supplement this source review; no old extraction/evidence/replays were regenerated.

pages.observation: Both columns read: 4.34-4.35, design note, 4.4 heading/counter/introduction and six separate list items, historical note, 4.5 introduction, 4.51-4.56 opening, exception and play note. Both explicit Line Command Eligibility Chart citations are indexed. Header, label, separator, copyright and blank page area inspected.

Both columns read: 4.56 continuation and two bullets; 4.6 body, exception and historical digression; 4.7 and 4.71-4.75 with design note; 4.8 introduction and 4.81-4.84 with design note. Leader Casualty Table and all visible numeric citations are retained. Other Leader Casualty occurrences describe an operation rather than citing a named source; humor rule is an editorial expression. Header/footer and blank page area inspected.

Both columns read: 4.85, 4.9 heading/counter, 4.91 introduction and two bullets, 4.92 introduction/three bullets/closing, 4.93-4.94, 5.0 heading/introduction/important box, 5.1 and 5.11-5.15 with both exception blocks and activation example, 5.2/5.21/example and 5.22 introduction. Stacking rules, Momentum rule and Trump Option are visibly explicit references and now indexed. Ordinary phase/term occurrences are not inferred citations. Header/footer and both continuation boundaries inspected.

Both columns read: 5.22 seven items/closing; 5.23 introduction/two items/closing; 5.24/example; 5.25; both 5.26 paragraphs and column continuation/example; 5.27-5.28 with two items/closing; 5.3 heading/note; 5.31 introduction/three bullets; 5.32/example; 5.33 introduction/three bullets; 5.34. Explicit Phase A, Phase B, both phase-D destinations and Trumping, below are now indexed. Header/footer and blank page area inspected.
